name: TLL Engineering Cognition Graph
description: Machine-readable engineering cognition graph for TLL OS. This is NOT a neural network. It is a machine-verifiable engineering world model. Nodes = engineering facts, Edges = engineering relations, Weights = evidence/confidence/impact, Time = history, Feedback = CI.

nodes.name: Crypto Standard Library
nodes.description: SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, hex conversion, constant-time compare.

nodes.name: Blockchain Standard Library
nodes.description: Block, Transaction, Chain, Merkle, PoW, Validation.

nodes.name: P2P Standard Library
nodes.description: Peer management, message framing, broadcast, connect, disconnect, reconnect.

nodes.name: 4-Node Blockchain Network
nodes.claim: TLL can run 4-node blockchain network with real TCP and real processes.

nodes.name: Ed25519 Asymmetric Signature
nodes.claim: TLL supports Ed25519 key generation, signing, verification.

nodes.name: FD_SETSIZE=64
nodes.description: Maximum 64 concurrent file descriptors. Exceeding results in silent ignore.

nodes.name: Function-Level Scope
nodes.description: TLL uses function-level scope. if/while/for do NOT create new lexical scope.

nodes.name: Windows TCC UNVERIFIED
nodes.description: TCC build environment damaged. TCC runtime not verified. Only MSVC counts for Windows.

nodes.name: Runtime Memory Leak Unverified
nodes.description: Source audit found no obvious leaks, but ASAN/valgrind runtime leak detection not performed.

nodes.name: P0-15.19 Cryptographic Foundation
nodes.description: Next phase: add Ed25519, SHA-512, secure random, Identity primitives, upgrade blockchain signatures.

nodes.name: P0-16.0 AI Native Foundation Bootstrap
nodes.description: Establish .tll-engine/ as official engineering cognition layer. No Runtime/Compiler modification.
